description: the road west at full dusk, empty, no caravan, a single traveler walking alone into fading light
a single small campfire against a vast dark landscape at night, no other travelers visible
a close view of a pair of hands by firelight, turning a coin over slowly
looking back over one's shoulder at an empty flat desert road at dusk, long stretched shadows, open bare desert on both sides, no buildings, no walls, no city, empty horizon
a vast star-filled night sky over an empty desert road, no moon
empty sand dunes at night under a full moon, bare open desert, nothing but sand and stars
